label: Golden Gate
note: SAE feature 13287 at block s5, clamped on a horizon band. Works on open outdoor scenes; close-ups only get lattice.

label: Golden Gate (2 neurons)
note: SDXL L17 N868 + L18 N695, the bridge hunt's answer: every prompt becomes a suspension bridge, towers and cables included. The slider scales both pushes.

label: Golden Gate (2 neurons, gentle)
note: The same pair at half strength (+1, +1): the bridge arrives and more of the scene survives (mean similarity 0.77 vs 0.69 at full strength; the Golden Gate is CLIP's top shift on 5 of 12 prompts). Slide above 1 for the full-strength version.

label: Bridge
note: L17 N868 pushed up: a bridge appears in every prompt (arch or girder); +2 is the sweet spot, more is not better.

label: Suspension bridge
note: L18 N695, the suspension-bridge neuron. At +1 to +2 it adds a suspension bridge and keeps the subject (boat, dog, street, portrait; similarity 0.92 at +1, 0.83 at +2); at +3 the subject gives way to towers. Pushed down on bridge prompts it removes the Golden Gate.

label: Dog
note: L18 N2683 pushed down: every prompt becomes a dog that keeps the prompt's world.

label: Fire & horror
note: L18 N5097 pushed down: fire breaks out and faces double and melt. The closest thing to an 'evil' unit in the sweeps.
